title: nail writes the mmseqs target db in parallel
body:
On the mgy run the db write takes 15.5 s, 3.2% of the run and the largest serial item. `write_mmseqs_sequence_database` in `mmseqs.rs` iterates 2.4M records through the serial `Database::iter`. Each `Database::get` costs a seek and a `read_exact`, then a parse into UTF-8 and digital byte vectors with a map lookup per residue. All of it runs on one thread, including the writes through a `BufWriter`.

## Proposal

A rayon loop over ranges of records builds one byte buffer per range, with each record's length. One sequential write then assigns the offsets. The query db write can run beside it on another thread.

## Cost

A sequential write of about 700 MB takes about 1 s on an SSD, which sets the floor. The estimate is 15 s down to 1 or 2 s. Nobody has measured it.
